name: demo-solar-system-model
description: Solar System Model demo — an end project that consumes the Hilos frontend SDK (@hilos/react).

scripts.build: vite build && vite build --ssr scripts/prerenderEntry.tsx --outDir dist-prerender && node dist-prerender/prerenderEntry.js && node node_modules/@hilos/core/bin/theme-head.mjs dist
scripts.test:table-geometry:build: tsc --noEmit -p tests/tableGeometry/tsconfig.json && vite build --config tests/tableGeometry/vite.config.ts && node node_modules/@hilos/core/bin/theme-head.mjs dist/__table_geometry
